body:
**Demo stage 1: live market** · unblocks #71

## What to build

A status record from the engine every block, on `status.base`, served by the API as `GET /status` and the `status` topic. It carries:

- Latest block number, hash and block time
- Lag to head, in blocks and in ms since the block's timestamp
- Pools tracked by venue (v2, v3), and by tier once #41 lands
- Shadow checks run and mismatches (D21)
- Whether inputs are being recorded, and the core instance ID
- Mode: live or replay, plus uptime

It's small, and it's the part of the demo that shows the backend itself working.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Status updates every block during `engine follow`, and replays identically from a recording (except the mode field)
- [ ] Lag is computed from block time, not the wall clock, inside the core (det rules)
- [ ] `docs/spec/observability.md` lists the fields

## Blocked by

- #78
title: Report the engine's live status: head, lag, pools tracked and shadow-check agreement
